findings.message: The relocated scripts retain the old root calculation, so direct invocation without AO_REPO_ROOT uses the assets directory as the repository root and fails. Both shell scripts still derive REPO_ROOT from their parent directory, which is now packages/cli/src/assets. Running the updater directly with --smoke-only reproduced MODULE_NOT_FOUND under src/assets/packages/agent-orchestrator/bin/ao.js. The doctor script likewise checks dependencies and builds beneath the incorrect root. The script tests supply AO_REPO_ROOT and therefore bypass this calculation.
